description:
The Mongoose Stance Scooter is the perfect beginner-level freestyle to hone your skills. This pro-style scooter will look rad gliding around town, but where it really excels is ripping through the urban jungle.
Lightweight alloy deck with extended standing area for pro-style scooter performance.
Alloy deck and steel brake combine with 100 mm high impact wheels and durable ABEC-7 bearings.
One-piece welded steel Y-bar handlebar with bike-style grips.
Triple anodized clamp collar for precise, crisp steering wherever you go.
Heavy-duty frame supports children 8+ up to 220 lbs.
